days.goal_en: Understand who we are and the five product lines.
days.goal_zh: 认识公司与五大业务线。

tasks.text_en: Read the company introduction and five business lines.
tasks.text_zh: 阅读公司介绍与五大业务线。

tasks.text_en: Complete the short quiz on product lines.
Tell your AI partner (the orb) one thing you learned today.
tasks.text_zh: 用一句话告诉 AI 搭档（光球）你今天学到什么。

days.done_message_en: Great start! You now know our five lines.
days.done_message_zh: 好的开始！你已认识五大业务。

days.goal_en: Learn when and how to handle condolence orders with care.
days.goal_zh: 学习如何温和处理帛事花圈。

tasks.text_en: Read the four cards for condolence wreaths.
tasks.text_zh: 阅读帛事花圈四张上手卡。

tasks.text_en: Practice a soft opening message that starts with condolences.
tasks.text_zh: 练习先慰问的温和开场。

tasks.text_en: Quiz on occasions and same-day conditions.
tasks.text_zh: 测验场合与当日送达条件。

days.done_message_en: You handled this with the right care.

days.goal_en: Know the occasions and how to recommend festive baskets.
days.goal_zh: 掌握开张花篮的场合与推荐方式。

tasks.text_en: Write a short WhatsApp message for a new shop opening.

days.goal_en: Match bouquets to personal occasions and handle photo requests.
days.goal_zh: 把花束匹配到个人场合并处理参考图。

tasks.text_en: Practice explaining that a photo is style reference only.
tasks.text_zh: 练习说明图片仅风格参考。

tasks.text_en: Quiz on suitable flowers and occasions.

days.done_message_en: You can now match the right bouquet.

days.goal_en: Understand full design and on-site setup offers.
days.goal_zh: 了解全案设计与现场布置。

tasks.text_en: Read the wedding and event cards.
tasks.text_zh: 阅读婚礼与活动上手卡。

tasks.text_en: Practice asking about the date and needs without pressure.
tasks.text_zh: 练习温和确认日期与需求。

days.done_message_en: Full design thinking is clear now.

days.goal_en: Identify trade customers and the pre-order process.
days.goal_zh: 识别行业客户与预订流程。

tasks.text_en: Quiz on who buys wholesale and pre-order rules.
tasks.text_zh: 测验批发对象与预订规则。

days.goal_en: Master reference photo rules and common objections, then prepare for certification.
days.goal_zh: 掌握参考图规则与异议处理，准备认证考试。

tasks.text_en: Review photo reference rules and objection answers.
tasks.text_zh: 复习参考图规则与异议回答。

tasks.text_en: Handle three sample situations: photo, freshness, and negative review.
tasks.text_zh: 处理三个情境：参考图、新鲜度、负评。

tasks.text_en: Remind yourself to take the certification exam (85% required to unlock orders).
tasks.text_zh: 提醒自己完成认证考试（85%才能解锁接单）。

days.done_message_en: Ready for the exam. Go for it!
